note: Proof audit: base n=1 uses det(1)=1 and the empty product convention. For n>=2, process columns in descending order so each source C_{k-1} is still original. The transformed (i,k) entry for k>=2 is (x_i-x_1)x_i^{k-2}; first row is (1,0,...,0). Laplace expansion has positive cofactor sign at (1,1). Factoring one scalar from each remaining row yields the exact recurrence. Induction product partitions all pairs into i=1 and 2<=i<j<=n. No division occurs, so repeated x-values cause no issue.
